To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) recurrent networks of rectified linear unit can learn long-term dependencies, (2) initializing the recurrent weight matrix with the identity matrix or a scaled version of it is sufficient to learn long-term dependencies and (3) our solution is comparable in performance to LSTMs.
recurrent neural networks composed solely of rectified linear unit activations can be trained to learn long-term dependencies, and that this can be accomplished with a simple initialization strategy.
initializing the recurrent weight matrix to be an identity or a scaled identity is a simple way to train recurrent networks of rectified linear unit that are comparable to LSTMs.

a simple way to initialize a recurrent neural network composed of rectified nonlinear units.
a fundamental question: can a simple network architecture and a simple initialization scheme be used to learn complex temporal structures?
the question whether the use of rectified linear activations is sufficient to learn long term dependencies in simple recurrent architectures.

our proposed initialization is simple, easy to implement, and can be a good replacement of LSTM initialization for RNNs composed of rectified nonlinearities.
